CPU state monitor (time-in-state, deep sleep) and wake lock inspector for Android.

Original: Brandon Valosek (2011)
Reloaded: zoffcc
Fork: tommynok (CPU Spy NG)

Quick Help:
• ⏰ Alarm / 📊 Chart — switch between CPU frequencies and Wakelocks (icon is dimmed/grey if access is unavailable). Supported elevation backends: Root (KernelSU / Magisk / APatch), Shizuku, and Porter.
• ∇ Funnel — wakelock filter ("Apps only" vs "All wakelocks + kernel").
